body: Upstream sooskca/project-memory branch memory-event-files at 4b55abe6ae46c53faf4f3f754665f61488e33fa9 implements the layout. Readers load events.jsonl in line order, then event JSON files in lexical filename order. Both add and supersede create files exclusively. Snapshot digests and index freshness cover both locations. GitHub ignores merge=union, so Modn removes that attribute and adds each new event as its own file.
summary: Use project-memory 0.2.0 or later. The memory/events directory selects one exclusive JSON file per event. Keep the legacy log unchanged and read it first.
supersession_reason: The approved upstream implementation now supports immutable event files.
title: Use immutable event files for conflict-free project memory
